blocks.title: Shipping costs, transit times and required documents from China to Kenya
blocks.body: China remains one of Kenya's largest import origins for electronics, machinery, textiles, industrial inputs and consumer goods. Kenya Tradex helps businesses compare sea and air freight options, plan transit times, prepare import documents and clear cargo through Mombasa or Nairobi with fewer delays.
paragraphs: Also shipping from other origins? See our shipping from Dubai , our 1 CBM shipping cost guide , or vehicle import services .
* Rates vary by season, port, and current market conditions. Contact us for real-time quotes.

For 1 CBM from China to Kenya, freight-only LCL pricing is commonly estimated around USD 80-150 per CBM on this guide. The real landed cost ranges between USD 420-500, and includes origin charges, destination handling, customs clearance, import duty, VAT, IDF, RDL, storage where applicable and final delivery. For a buying decision, compare the freight quote with the total landed cost, not the sea freight line alone.

Need to estimate a small shipment? Our 1 CBM shipping cost from China to Kenya guide explains when LCL makes sense and what charges to expect around freight, clearing and delivery. Read the 1 CBM guide .

Cost of shipping a 20ft container from China to Kenya: Importers often compare a 20ft FCL container against LCL once cargo moves beyond small-pallet volume. A 20ft container can make sense when the shipment is heavy, bulky, sensitive, or commercially urgent enough to justify dedicated space instead of shared consolidation.
items: Ocean Freight (FCL/LCL): Full container (20ft/40ft) or shared container options from Shanghai, Ningbo, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, and Tianjin.
Air Freight: Express delivery from Shanghai Pudong (PVG), Guangzhou (CAN), Shenzhen (SZX) to Nairobi (NBO) in 3-5 days.
Customs Clearance: Full KRA customs processing at Mombasa port or JKIA airport. We handle all documentation.
Door-to-Door Delivery: Transport from Mombasa port to your warehouse in Nairobi, Kisumu, Mombasa, or anywhere in Kenya.
Transit Bonds: For cargo continuing to Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, DRC, or South Sudan via Northern Corridor.
Cargo Insurance: All-risk coverage available for your shipment during transit.

blocks.title: Major Chinese Ports for Kenya Shipping
items: Shanghai (SHA): China's largest port, most frequent sailings to Mombasa (weekly departures). Best for general cargo and electronics.
Ningbo (NGB): Major hub for machinery, industrial equipment, and auto parts. Competitive rates.
Guangzhou (Huangpu/Nansha): Ideal for textiles, garments, furniture, and consumer goods from the Pearl River Delta.
Shenzhen (Yantian): Best for electronics, high-tech products, and e-commerce cargo. Fast loading times.
Tianjin (TSN): Gateway to Beijing and northern China. Good for automotive parts, steel, and heavy machinery.

blocks.title: Documents Required for Import from China to Kenya
blocks.body: Kenya Tradex handles all documentation and customs clearance. Request quote →
items: Bill of Lading (Sea) / Airway Bill (Air): Proof of shipment issued by carrier
Commercial Invoice: Detailed list of goods with values and HS codes
Packing List: Itemized list of cargo with weights and dimensions
Import Declaration Form (IDF): Obtained from KRA before cargo arrival
KEBS Certificate of Conformity (CoC): Required for regulated products (electronics, toys, food contact materials)

items: Step 1: Share your cargo details (product type, volume, origin port, destination).
Step 2: We provide all-inclusive quote and book space with our carrier partners.

Step 5: We handle all customs clearance with KRA upon arrival.
Step 6: Cargo delivered to your warehouse anywhere in Kenya.

blocks.title: Frequently Asked Questions - China to Kenya Shipping
items:
How long does shipping from China to Kenya take? 
Ocean freight from China to Mombasa takes 20-30 days depending on the port of origin. Air freight takes 3-5 days. Kenya Tradex handles the entire process from pickup in China to delivery in Kenya.

What is the cheapest way to ship from China to Kenya? 
Sea freight (ocean freight) is the cheapest way to ship from China to Kenya. A 20ft container typically costs USD 1,500-3,000, while air freight costs significantly more (USD 5-8 per kg). For smaller shipments under 15 CBM, LCL (shared container) is most cost-effective.

How much does a 20ft container cost from China to Kenya? 
Shipping a 20ft container from China to Kenya typically costs between USD 1,500 and USD 3,000 depending on the port of origin (Shanghai, Ningbo, Guangzhou, Shenzhen), current market rates, and seasonal demand. Contact Kenya Tradex for real-time pricing.

How much is 1 CBM shipping from China to Kenya? 
A 1 CBM shipment usually moves as LCL. Freight-only pricing on this guide is commonly estimated around USD 80-150 per CBM, but the landed cost also includes origin charges, destination handling, customs clearance, taxes and local delivery.

What are the major Chinese ports for shipping to Kenya? 
Major ports include Shanghai, Ningbo, Guangzhou (Huangpu/Nansha), Shenzhen (Yantian), and Tianjin. Shipping from Shanghai and Ningbo typically offers more frequent sailings and competitive rates.

What documents are required to import from China to Kenya? 
Required documents include: Bill of Lading (sea) or Airway Bill (air), Commercial Invoice, Packing List, KRA Import Declaration Form (IDF), and KEBS Certificate of Conformity (CoC) for regulated products. Kenya Tradex handles all documentation.
